announced or imposed, to what extent other countries implement tariffs or other retaliatory measures in response, and the 
overall magnitude and duration of these measures. Trade and other international disputes can have an adverse impact on the 
overall macroeconomic environment and result in shifts and reductions in consumer spending and negative consumer sentiment
